about: Benchmark corpus for docs/assessment-2026-09-14.md §9. Entry titles: existing books from STRATEGY.md 'Convergence sets' and 'Single cases' (Živago from docs/Task.md); N1-N24 from §9, with the original title as the UC3 entry. query_author is the author string sent with every entry title: the form the regression tables use for existing books, the §9 form for new ones. ground_truth is filled in step 1 of Stage 1. Ground truth: facts from Wikipedia article text, national-library records (SBN, LoC, BnF, DNB) or the publisher; never from Wikidata. Raw evidence: results/stage-1/gt_catalogues.json, gt_wikipedia.json.
